import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v14';batch='resumed-low-v14-auto-1-20261025';commit='8b2dfdfb684e0b8ded257784a22e18510ef4b86a'
state_path=ROOT/f'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-{run}.json';state=read_json(state_path)
publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';prior=read_json(publication)
assert state['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay' and state['last_checkpoint_requests']==0 and state['checkpoints'][0]['commit']==commit
assert prior['commit']==commit and prior['status']=='push_pending_inspection_required' and '180 seconds' in prior['error']
assert state['original_deadline_utc']=='2026-10-26T04:14:59.205420+00:00'
assert not (state_path.parent/'publisher.lock').exists()
wait_end=datetime.fromisoformat(state['original_deadline_utc'])
while (ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock').exists():
    assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<wait_end,'Original Git deadline reached while another task owns its lock; preserve without deletion'
    time.sleep(5)
failures=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures';saved=[]
for source,suffix in [(state_path,'publisher-state'),(publication,'publication')]:
    target=failures/f'20261026-v14-first-publish-lock-timeout-original-{suffix}.json'
    with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(source.read_bytes())
    assert file_sha256(source)==file_sha256(target)
    saved.append({'path':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(target)})
audit=failures/'20261026-v14-first-publish-lock-timeout.json';assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'actual_original_publisher_session_id':50161,'actual_original_exit_code':1,'fixed_commit':commit,'retry_wrapper_process_id':os.getpid(),'preserved_original_bytes':saved,'scope':'Original Git-only publisher timed out after180s while another task held the shared publication lock. Both locks now actually absent. Retry only the same immutable snapshot; no image replay, duplicate checkpoint, lock deletion, deadline reset or remote-history rewrite.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'fixed_commit_git_only_retry_started':commit,'process_id':os.getpid()}),flush=True)
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),commit,batch],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=2400)
assert result.returncode==0,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
pub=read_json(publication);proof_path=ROOT/pub['remote_original_readback'];proof=read_json(proof_path)
assert pub['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified' and proof['status']=='verified' and proof['commit']==commit
assert read_json(state_path)==state
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v14-first-publication-reconciled.json';assert not target.exists()
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'completed_at_utc':utc_now(),'fixed_commit':commit,'original_failure':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'original_failure_sha256':file_sha256(audit),'actual_retry_publisher_exit_code':0,'retry_wrapper_process_id':os.getpid(),'actual_verified_readback':proof,'checkpoint_requests':16,'new_original_PNGs':17,'scope':'The original16-completed-call snapshot captured17 new PNGs because production continued while snapshotting. Actual original bytes verified; this is not17 approved portraits or17 completed snapshot calls. Same finite publisher may continue from16 without replay.'})
state.update(status='reconciled_checkpoint_requires_same_run_continuation',last_checkpoint_requests=16,last_commit=commit,reconciled_at_utc=utc_now(),reconciliation=target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),reconciliation_sha256=file_sha256(target))
write_json(state_path,state)
print(json.dumps({'reconciled':True,'commit':commit,'verified_at_utc':proof['completed_at_utc'],'checkpoint_requests':16,'new_original_PNGs':17,'publisher_running':False,'original_deadline_utc':state['original_deadline_utc']}),flush=True)
